name: GoPro Drone
notes: Motor order FL, FR, RL, RR; axes left, back, up in meters. Inertia is about the center of mass. Mass 850 g is the estimated as-built weight (the Onshape model gives 808.8 g). CG and motor positions come from the Onshape hotdawgMode STEP (2026-11-18), moved from its front-bottom-lip origin so the rear motor axes stay at y = 75.381 mm and the motor mounting faces at z = 7 mm. Inertia is the earlier Onshape tensor scaled by 850/808.8. Thrust is one motor's static thrust on 6S: the median of three thrust-stand sweeps (2026-11-06), flattened above 95%. Geometry edits do not automatically recalculate mass properties.
